Outcome_variable.evidence_source: The text discusses 'identity trajectories' and 'Classes 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 (troubled diffusion, carefree diffusion, achievement, troubled diffusion-to-moratorium, and moratorium-to-achievement, respectively)' which are not subjective well-being components.

sample_type.evidence_source: individuals in the early-to-middle adolescent age group were more likely to belong to Classes 1 and 3 (troubled diffusion and carefree diffusion, respectively) than were individuals in the middle-to-late adolescent age group, whereas individuals in the middle-to-late adolescent age group were more likely to belong to Classes 2, 4, and 5 (achievement, troubled diffusionto-moratorium, and moratorium-to-achievement, respectively). Regarding regional differences, rural adolescents were more likely to belong to the achievement and moratorium-to-achievement trajectories than urban adolescents, whereas urban adolescents were more likely to belong to the troubled diffusion, troubled diffusionto-moratorium, and carefree diffusion trajectories.
